text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break at training camp, Mejiro 
McQueen was gazing at what appeared to be 
a thick book.
choice_data_list: What about that book?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you interested too, Trainer? Would 
you like to take a look together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I line up next to Mejiro McQueen, who is 
beckoning to me. Looking at the book, I 
see—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Lined up here are photographs capturing 
the glorious history of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"This photo is one of them. The shield 
earned at the end of a grueling 
3,200-meter journey... A precious memory 
for my grandmothers as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In Mejiro, there is a path forged by proud 
umamusume. So one day, I too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—I want to stand at that same summit. For 
the sake of everyone who shared their 
dream with me and loved it.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She tenderly traced each photograph in the 
album with her eyes. It seemed to convey 
just how deeply her feelings had grown...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, just one. There was one photo that had 
a different atmosphere from the rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a photograph of a beautiful 
plateau. Just looking at it, you could 
almost hear the sound of the wind...
choice_data_list: ...It's a really beautiful place.
...It's such a beautiful place, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
Well... those are from when the Mejiro 
predecessors participated in summer 
training camp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ardan-san? When did you come over 
here...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Shall I show you the way to where 
this photo was taken? ...Though it does 
lie at the end of a rather rugged path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'The journey will be so grueling it'll 
practically double as training.' ...That's 
what Mejiro Ardan said."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
According to the materials we received, 
it's up the hill past the bushes on the 
left. Come, let us go at once!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa, phew... The breeze feels so nice...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, accompanied by a cheerful Mejiro 
McQueen, we set off for the location in 
the photo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Trainer-san! We still have 
to follow the road for a while...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!? A hornet!?
choice_data_list: Let's run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... The grass is so thick, 
and there are so many bugs... It's truly 
untouched nature, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the map, I point out a detour 
for Mejiro McQueen, who is determined to 
keep going regardless. But—
choice_data_list:
(...I don't want to push her any further 
than this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The unpaved road will likely continue 
ahead. And on top of that..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The scenery seen at the destination should 
be the same as in the photograph. No 
matter how beautiful a view it may be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eep... Th-This is a bridge...!? ...*Gulp*.
choice_data_list: ...You know, you can always turn back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I have yet to reach the location 
shown in the photograph.
choice_data_list:
Why do you want to see the scenery in that 
photo so badly?

Why do you want to see the scenery in that 
photo so badly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
! That's because... ...I believe this is 
the same.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you leave it as just photos and 
imagination, it will never become 
reality—it will merely end as an idealized 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is quite all right, Trainer. Even if 
the bridge is old and precarious, with 
your hand to hold, I can keep moving 
forward.
choice_data_list: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her hand, we cross bridges and 
climb hills. Never looking back, simply 
pressing forward—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: This is the place from the photo...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, yes... But it's so much more than 
what a photo could show—
choice_data_list: It's beautiful...
It's beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was supposed to be the same scenery as 
the photo. Yet the sight in reality was 
far more vivid, with the scent of flowers 
tickling our noses—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I must never let this end as merely a 
photograph or a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Had I not stood upon this ground, the 
fragrance of blooming flowers, the rustle 
of leaves... I would never have known true 
beauty at all."
choice_data_list: ...McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
More than photos, more than imagination, 
more than dreams. If reality is far more 
beautiful, then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes were gazing at a scenery "beyond" 
this place. ...In the direction leading to 
her dream's path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on the 3,200-meter stage, which 
will undoubtedly be far more grueling than 
any distance walked before.
choice_data_list: (Surely, what she's looking at is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Above all, I want to take first place in 
the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The dream that Grandmother and everyone 
supporting me see through my running... I 
want to make that dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And just like today, I want you to savor 
with your own eyes and feel firsthand... 
that the sight is far more wonderful than 
you ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her goal hasn't changed since the day we 
met. It is to claim the Emperor's 
Shield—the long-cherished wish of the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little embarrassed to admit I got 
carried away. Being so close to the sky—it 
just felt so good.
choice_data_list:
Maybe our predecessors talked about their 
dreams just like this.

Maybe our predecessors talked about their 
dreams the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
! I see, so that's why they went out of 
their way to keep a photo of this place in 
the album...
choice_data_list:
Let's capture our resolve today in a photo 
too.

Let's take a photo to remember today's 
resolution too.
Let's burn this scenery into our memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
! I see, so that's why they went out of 
their way to keep a photo of this place in 
the album...
choice_data_list:
Let's capture our resolve today in a photo 
too.

Let's take a photo to remember today's 
resolution too.
Let's burn this scenery into our memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So that we never forget the determination 
we felt today. And someday, when we look 
back at that photograph—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that underclassmen will come along who 
wish to see this view with their own eyes 
and pledge their dreams here, just like 
Mejiro McQueen today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Let us remember with our own eyes just 
how truly beautiful the scenery left 
behind in those nostalgic photographs by 
our predecessors really is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To achieve a scenery together that is far 
more vivid than any photo or dream—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And for a while, I continued to gaze out 
at the scenery alongside Mejiro McQueen.
